inputs.text: The Jaipur ceremony looks like a familiar playbook: let the student’s protest circulate, then say nothing and wait for attention to fade. The argument over what was “appropriate” conveniently pulls focus from the issues she raised. That silence isn’t just image management; it’s how those in charge keep control of the story while avoiding answers and ensuring the students’ concerns lose traction.
